notes:
Summary: Emberline provides an AI-driven contact center layer for mid-market e-comm and fintech support orgs. Looking to replace a brittle rule-based KB+snippets setup with RAG-backed agent assist + live tool-calling to update CRMs. Primary pain: inconsistent citations, stale KB articles, and major spikes during campaigns (Black Friday-like events).

Recent activity:
- 2024-10-18 discovery call (Jordan/Priya + Head of CX, SRE lead). Customer demo of current agent workflow (Zendesk + Salesforce).
- 2024-10-25 architecture workshop (recording: ff_2024-10-18_emberline_kickoff). Discussed ingestion: Zendesk articles, Confluence KB, call transcripts, product changelog.
- 2024-11-07 security deep-dive with infra (SOC2 scope, SSO/SAML, KMS integration). Action items on residency and retention.
- 2024-11-12 trial token provisioned for Hosted API tests; initial QPS smoke run.

Requirements / acceptance criteria (customer language / paraphrase):
- Agent assist latency: 200-350ms 95p for suggestion fetch (must include retrieval + model inference).
- Ticket summarization: <= 2s for single-ticket summary, high factuality and clear citation of source docs.
- RAG: multi-source retrieval across Zendesk, Confluence, and S3-hosted release notes. Must return top-3 citations with link/ID and freshness indicator.
- Tool-calling: ability to push tags and post internal notes into Zendesk/Salesforce from assistant; idempotent operations and retry on 429/5xx.
- Reliability: survive 3x baseline traffic spikes for marketing events; target 99.95% availability during spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: willing to trade-off model size for cost; prefer quantized model paths for non-critical tasks.

POC plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0: ingest representative slice (3 months) of KB + 10k tickets + 2k call transcripts. Verify vectorization and chunking strategy.
- Week 1: baseline retrieval + hosted small LLM (open model) for offline eval of citations & precision. Build eval set with 200 golden prompts.
- Week 2: integrate private/dedicated option for latency tests; simulate 2x and 3x traffic spikes with replay harness.
- Week 3: tool-calling demo end-to-end (Zendesk update flow), security checklist, handover doc and decision checkpoint.

Technical notes / customer preferences (shorthand):
- Prefer sparse + dense hybrid retrieval; initial eval with semantic vectors in Milvus + term boosting from Elastic.
- Freshness window: prefer 24h reindex for changelog; KB articles reindexed nightly. "Must flag docs updated <7d".
- Citation format: source ID + snippet + direct link; legal asked for auditable citation trace.
- Want rollbacks and fallback to cached canonical answers when upstream services time out.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching & quantization; curious about KV-cache reuse for multi-turn agent sessions.

Quotes / snippets from stakeholders:
- "If the agent doesn't see the right doc in <300ms they lose the customer — it's non-negotiable." — Head of CX.
- "We need to know where the answer came from; compliance will require an audit trail." — Legal.

Open questions / blockers:
- Confirm EU data residency plan and whether Private deployment is required.
- Which vector DB do we recommend for 10M+ vectors and sub-100ms recall under load? (customer leaning toward Milvus or Pinecone).
- Cost modeling: fixed monthly Dedicated vs usage-based Hosted for bursty patterns (marketing spikes).

Next steps (short):
- Schedule POC kickoff (Jordan, Priya, SRE, Head of CX) week of 2024-11-18.
- Share POC success criteria doc + trial keys.
- Legal to provide draft residency acceptance criteria by 2024-11-22.

- Jira spike: ENG-7891 (ingestion performance) referenced in call.
- Support: SUP-1423 created for initial throughput regression during trial.
